name: Nagare Workation Hotel
description: Nagare Workation Hotel is a calm block theme for lakeside hotels that rent rooms by the week and by the month to people who bring their work. The home page opens on three unequal full-height panes: a documentary photograph that wipes between three moments of a guest's week, a pale text pane with the title and a four-figure row, and a narrow lake sliver; then a sideways strip of the week, a label-cell price board with a very light numeral, a seam portrait that crosses a lake band, the coworking floor and the one way to book. Red Hat Display and Nunito Sans, documentary photography, quiet scroll effects.
